title: A股港股早报：黄金居行业榜首，夜盘指数微升而科技广度偏弱 + 美股盘前：期指反弹但长债高压，加密链与折扣零售获盘前正反馈
summary: Moomoo行业全榜145个行业仅49涨96跌，黄金、铜与油气居前，太阳能与折扣零售承压；QQQ、SPY、DIA夜盘ETF代理小涨，10只panel代表股为4项确认、6项不可得。阿里、网易、中国平安财报与港股竞价信号分化，正式开盘量价优先。 纳指、道指与标普500期指分别约涨0.6%、0.4%和0.3%，但10年期与30年期美债收益率约4.70%和5.25%，周线压力未解。比特币本周涨约22%并带动加密链延续盘前强势，Ross Stores财报后盘前涨近9%；今晚无可验证大型科技财报样本。

entries.summary_en: Only 49 of 145 Moomoo industries rose while 96 fell; gold, copper and drilling led, while solar and discount stores lagged. QQQ, SPY and DIA overnight ETF proxies edged higher, and the 10 panel representatives produced four confirmations and six unavailable prints. Alibaba, NetEase and Ping An earnings and Hong Kong auction signals diverged, making formal opening price and volume decisive.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
美国升级对伊朗经济施压，油价与长端利率再抬头
美联社8月20日报道，美国威胁对伊朗实施更严厉的经济隔离和二级制裁；布伦特原油上涨2.4%至93.78美元，10年期美债收益率回升至约4.70%。事实层面对黄金、铜油等资源形成支撑，但高油价与高利率同时压制航空、消费和高估值成长。
国际
西岸定居点争议扩大，中东风险溢价难以快速消退
英国、法国、德国、意大利、荷兰、挪威与加拿大共同要求以色列撤回东耶路撒冷附近新增逾1200套住房的项目，埃及和约旦亦表示反对。事件对A/H盈利的直接影响有限，但说明中东政治风险仍可能经油价、航运和避险需求传导。
科技
Moomoo行业全榜显示黄金居首、太阳能与航天防务垫底
本次完整读取Moomoo美股行业榜5页、145个行业：黄金+2.69%、农业投入+2.63%、化学品+2.29%、铜+2.25%、油气钻探+2.12%居前；按跌幅排序的末端为按揭金融-3.55%、钢铁-3.67%、航天防务-3.72%、太阳能-4.10%、折扣零售-6.43%。全榜仅49涨、96跌，A/H资源映射明确，但市场广度偏弱。
科技
Sparks加密与存储主题领跑，题材强度明显高于大盘
Futunn/Moomoo Sparks显示加密储备+7.91%、BTCT+75.69%，存储概念+3.72%、SKHY+4.43%；隔夜美光上涨3.97%。加密链对A/H主要映射为港股虚拟资产平台和券商题材，事件性强；存储链则映射兆易创新、江波龙与服务器供应链，需放量确认。
科技
光通信上涨但内部多数下跌，CPO只能选择性交易
Sparks光通信主题+0.65%，Lumentum上涨6.24%，但主题内部仅7涨、14跌；LITE当前夜盘又回落0.435%。A股中际旭创、新易盛等具直接映射，但若开盘后不能强于通信设备指数并放量，隔夜领涨更可能是个股驱动而非板块扩散。
科技
Marvell大涨带动定制芯片，半导体行业上涨却广度不足
Moomoo半导体行业+0.75%，Marvell上涨5.79%；其与Google扩大定制AI芯片合作继续强化ASIC、网络与高速互连逻辑。不过行业仅19涨、52跌，MRVL当前夜盘回落0.521%，A/H映射应优先看CPO、国产算力和晶圆代工的量价承接，而非追逐整个芯片板块。
财报
阿里营收略超预期但每股收益显著不及预期
Futu财报日历显示阿里巴巴2027财年第一季度营收2689.53亿元，略高于预期2683.22亿元；EPS为0.46，低于预期1.4752。BABA隔夜现金时段收涨约1.26%，当前夜盘-0.199%；09988.HK于09:01 CST竞价参考约130港元，较昨收高约3.01%，最终仍以开盘成交确认。
财报
网易营收超预期、每股收益不及预期，跨市场反馈分化
网易二季度营收301.07亿元，高于预期294.82亿元；EPS为2.17，低于预期3.1368。NTES现金时段下跌约5.85%，当前夜盘+0.325%；09999.HK于09:00 CST竞价参考约206.8港元、较昨收高约6.93%，低成交竞价与美股反馈冲突，不能在开盘前定性为利多。
财报
中国平安盈利指标超预期，竞价参考价呈正反馈
Futu财报日历显示中国平安二季度EPS为4.60，高于预期4.49；EBIT为1307.5亿元，高于预期约1030.85亿元。02318.HK于09:01 CST竞价参考约55.60港元、较昨收高约2.77%；若开盘后金融权重放量且守住54.10港元昨收，业绩映射才算有效。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘指数：三大ETF代理小幅转正，尚不足以扭转现金时段下跌
Futu OpenD订阅行情于2026-08-21 08:59 CST（约08/20 20:59 EDT）显示：QQQ（纳指100代理）+0.108%、SPY（标普500代理）+0.051%、DIA（道指代理）+0.084%。这些是ETF夜盘代理而非指数期货；源未标示延迟，API未提供单独逐笔时间，因此按本次抓取快照披露。
板块对照
板块对照：资源与太阳能压力获确认，六只代表股无夜盘成交
逐项复核panel：黄金/BGL +8.362%确认，农业投入/BIOX不可得，化学品/MEOH不可得，铜/ERO +0.666%确认，油气钻探/SOC不可得；按揭金融/PAPL不可得，钢铁/HUDI -0.814%确认，航天防务/PRZO不可得，太阳能/BEEM -2.941%确认，折扣零售/TBBB不可得。合计4项确认、6项不可得，0项背离、0项潜在反转。
A/H映射
A/H映射：资源与财报股竞价偏强，但低成交信号仍需开盘复核
香港竞价在09时00分与09时01分（CST）的参考价显示紫金矿业H约+5.88%、山东黄金H约+1.66%、阿里约+3.01%、网易约+6.93%、中国平安约+2.77%，泡泡玛特约-5.47%；A股尚未进入有效竞价。若资源股守住昨收且QQQ保持正值，资源与选择性科技可延续；若竞价缺口快速回补或油价推高利率，则夜盘增量信号失效。

盘前结论

Moomoo行业榜中黄金、铜与油气钻探居前，BGL和ERO夜盘同向确认，叠加QQQ、SPY、DIA三只ETF代理均小幅转正，A/H开盘优先观察贵金属、有色和能源的相对强势。但145个行业仅49涨、96跌，太阳能、航天防务与折扣零售位于末端，10年期美债约4.70%和布油93.78美元继续压制高估值与成本敏感板块。

科技不是全面风险偏好回归：存储Sparks+3.72%，半导体行业+0.75%、光通信+0.65%，但半导体广度19涨52跌、光通信7涨14跌，且MRVL与LITE夜盘分别回落0.521%和0.435%。短线只做有成交确认的CPO、存储和国产算力。

港股竞价参考对紫金、阿里、网易和平安偏正，但当前成交代表性有限，尤其网易与美股现金反馈冲突。09:30后若紫金矿业H守住36.76港元、阿里守住126.20港元且半导体/光通信成交扩散，可保留进攻；否则转向黄金、保险等现金流方向并降低追高。

黄金行业领涨 伊朗能源风险 长端利率高位 加密储备 存储链 光通信窄涨 定制ASIC 芯片广度偏弱 太阳能压力 阿里财报混合 网易价格分化 港股竞价验证
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

紫金矿业
02899.HK
金铜双映射

推荐理由：黄金行业+2.69%居首、铜行业+2.25%，BGL与ERO夜盘均同向确认；公司同时承接黄金与铜价逻辑。

触发因素：正式开盘后守住36.76港元昨收，且成交放大并强于恒指及同业。

风险点：09:00竞价参考约+5.88%可能含低成交噪声；油价推高利率或贵金属回落会放大高开回撤。

兆易创新
603986.SH
存储映射

推荐理由：Sparks存储主题上涨3.72%，SKHY与美光均获得正反馈，A股存储与控制器链具直接映射。

触发因素：A股开盘后存储板块成交扩散，603986.SH强于半导体指数并守住403.50元昨收。

风险点：半导体行业内部19涨52跌，若美光或MRVL夜盘转弱扩大，存储链可能高开低走。

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO选择性映射

推荐理由：Lumentum现金时段上涨6.24%，Marvell与Google定制芯片合作继续强化高速互连需求。

触发因素：开盘后中际旭创放量强于通信设备指数，且光模块同业同步走强而非单股脉冲。

风险点：光通信仅7涨14跌，LITE夜盘回落0.435%，若广度不改善不宜追高。

阿里巴巴-W
09988.HK
财报混合验证

推荐理由：营收略超预期，BABA现金时段最终收涨约1.26%，显示早盘负反馈被部分吸收。

触发因素：正式开盘后守住126.20港元昨收，云业务与平台互联网权重同步获得成交支持。

风险点：EPS显著低于预期，当前夜盘-0.199%；若竞价高开快速回补，按风险观察处理。

中国平安
02318.HK
盈利超预期

推荐理由：二季度EPS与EBIT均高于Futu一致预期，金融权重在高利率环境下具相对现金流优势。

触发因素：开盘后守住54.10港元昨收并放量，保险与银行权重共同走强。

风险点：竞价参考约+2.77%尚未形成有效成交；长端利率过快上升仍会压制资产估值。

板块轮动看板

受益方向黄金、铜、油气与存储；黄金和铜代表股夜盘确认，资源链优先于全市场追涨。
观察方向CPO、定制ASIC、国产算力、平台互联网与保险；只保留正式开盘后的量价确认。
压力方向太阳能、航天防务、钢铁与折扣零售；其中太阳能BEEM夜盘再跌2.941%，A/H光伏不作多头推荐。
验证信号紫金与山东黄金能否守住昨收、QQQ是否保持正值、半导体/光通信广度、阿里与网易竞价缺口是否回补。

逻辑链

美国对伊朗施压推高油价和长端利率，美股现金时段三大指数下跌，宏观风险偏好仍弱。
Moomoo完整行业榜中黄金、铜与油气居前，而太阳能、航天防务和折扣零售位于末端，资源与成本敏感板块明显分化。
Futu夜盘显示BGL、ERO、HUDI与BEEM同向确认，但六只panel代表股无成交，不能把局部延续外推为全市场趋势。
Sparks存储、光通信和半导体提供A/H科技映射，但行业广度偏弱，交易条件转为开盘后量价确认。
若资源股守住昨收、QQQ为正且科技成交扩散，可保持选择性进攻；若利率继续上升或竞价缺口回补，则降低高估值仓位。

风险雷达

中东与油价再升级

伊朗制裁和海湾航运风险可能继续推高油价、通胀与亚洲进口成本。

美债长端重回高位

10年期收益率约4.70%，若继续上行将压制高估值科技与港股成长。

科技上涨缺乏广度

半导体19涨52跌、光通信7涨14跌，少数权重上涨可能掩盖内部疲弱。

竞价参考价失真

港股09:00后的价格成交有限，紫金、网易等高开指示不等于正式趋势。

太阳能压力向A/H扩散

美股太阳能行业跌4.10%且BEEM夜盘确认下跌，光伏链需防估值与供给双重压力。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（2026-08-21 08:53 CST抓取，页面显示08/20 20:53 ET；完整读取5页、145行业，49涨96跌，黄金与贵金属已重点核验）；Futunn/Moomoo Sparks初始状态主题榜（08:57 CST抓取，存储、加密、光通信与半导体交叉核验）；Futu OpenD订阅的QQQ/SPY/DIA及10只panel代表股夜盘字段（08:59 CST抓取，约08/20 20:59 EDT；源未标示延迟，API未单列逐笔时间）；Futu HK/SH/SZ财报日历、NOTICE搜索、财报价格与港股竞价快照（08:58—09:01 CST）；AP关于8月20日美国—伊朗、中东定居点、美股、美债与油价；Marvell—Google合作公开报道。指数现金收盘为8月20日美东时段。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Global
US escalates economic pressure on Iran as oil and long yields rise again
AP reported on Aug. 20 that the US threatened tougher economic isolation and secondary sanctions against Iran. Brent gained 2.4% to $93.78 and the 10-year Treasury yield returned to about 4.70%. These facts support gold, copper and upstream oil, but higher energy and rates hurt airlines, consumers and long-duration growth.
Global
West Bank settlement dispute widens as Middle East risk premium persists
The UK, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway and Canada jointly urged Israel to withdraw a project for more than 1,200 homes near East Jerusalem; Egypt and Jordan also objected. The direct earnings impact on A/H is limited, but political risk can still transmit through oil, shipping and safe-haven demand.
Tech
Full Moomoo industry scan puts gold first and solar and aerospace near the bottom
This run read all five Moomoo US industry pages and 145 industries. Gold +2.69%, agricultural inputs +2.63%, chemicals +2.29%, copper +2.25% and oil & gas drilling +2.12% led. The bottom sequence was mortgage finance -3.55%, steel -3.67%, aerospace & defense -3.72%, solar -4.10% and discount stores -6.43%. Only 49 industries rose versus 96 down, giving resources a clear A/H mapping but leaving market breadth weak.
Tech
Sparks crypto and storage themes lead by much more than the broad market
Futunn/Moomoo Sparks showed crypto treasury +7.91% with BTCT +75.69%, and data storage +3.72% with SKHY +4.43%; Micron rose 3.97% in the cash session. Crypto maps mainly to Hong Kong virtual-asset platforms and broker themes and is highly event-driven. Storage maps more directly to GigaDevice, Longsys and server suppliers but still needs volume confirmation.
Tech
Optical communication rises while most constituents fall, limiting CPO breadth
The Sparks optical communication theme gained 0.65% and Lumentum rose 6.24%, but breadth was only seven up versus 14 down; LITE then slipped 0.435% overnight. Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink are direct A-share mappings, but failure to beat the communications equipment index on volume would suggest a stock-specific move rather than sector expansion.
Tech
Marvell drives custom silicon higher while semiconductor breadth stays weak
Moomoo's semiconductor industry gained 0.75% and Marvell rose 5.79% as its expanded Google custom-AI-chip partnership reinforced the ASIC, networking and high-speed interconnect thesis. Yet breadth was only 19 up versus 52 down and MRVL slipped 0.521% overnight. A/H mapping should prioritize confirmed CPO, domestic compute and foundry strength rather than chase the whole chip group.
Earnings
Alibaba revenue edges above consensus while EPS misses sharply
Futu's earnings calendar showed fiscal 2027 first-quarter revenue of RMB268.953 billion versus RMB268.322 billion expected, while EPS of 0.46 missed the 1.4752 estimate. BABA rose about 1.26% in the cash session and is -0.199% overnight. At 09:01 CST, 09988.HK had an indicative auction price near HK$130, about 3.01% above the prior close, still requiring opening-volume confirmation.
Earnings
NetEase beats revenue but misses EPS as cross-market price signals diverge
NetEase second-quarter revenue was RMB30.107 billion versus RMB29.482 billion expected, while EPS of 2.17 missed 3.1368. NTES fell about 5.85% in the cash session and is +0.325% overnight. At 09:00 CST, 09999.HK indicated near HK$206.80, about 6.93% above the prior close. That low-volume auction signal conflicts with the US reaction and cannot yet be called bullish.
Earnings
Ping An earnings metrics beat as the auction indication turns positive
Futu's calendar showed Ping An second-quarter EPS of 4.60 versus 4.49 expected and EBIT of RMB130.75 billion versus about RMB103.085 billion expected. At 09:01 CST, 02318.HK indicated near HK$55.60, about 2.77% above the prior close. The earnings mapping is valid only if financials add volume after the open and the stock holds HK$54.10.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indexes
Overnight indexes: all three ETF proxies edge higher but do not erase cash-session losses
Futu OpenD subscribed quotes at 2026-08-21 08:59 CST, about 08/20 20:59 EDT, showed QQQ, the Nasdaq-100 proxy, +0.108%; SPY, the S&P 500 proxy, +0.051%; and DIA, the Dow proxy, +0.084%. These are overnight ETF proxies, not index futures. The source showed no delay flag and the API did not provide a separate tick timestamp, so they are disclosed as a fetched snapshot.
Sector Check
Sector check: resources and solar pressure confirm while six representatives do not trade
Panel checks: Gold/BGL +8.362% confirmation; Agricultural Inputs/BIOX unavailable; Chemicals/MEOH unavailable; Copper/ERO +0.666% confirmation; Oil & Gas Drilling/SOC unavailable; Mortgage Finance/PAPL unavailable; Steel/HUDI -0.814% confirmation; Aerospace & Defense/PRZO unavailable; Solar/BEEM -2.941% confirmation; Discount Stores/TBBB unavailable. Total: four confirmations, six unavailable, zero divergences and zero potential reversals.
A/H Mapping
A/H mapping: resources and earnings names indicate higher, but thin auctions need an open check
Indicative prices from the 09:00 and 09:01 CST snapshots showed Zijin Mining H about +5.88%, Shandong Gold H about +1.66%, Alibaba about +3.01%, NetEase about +6.93%, Ping An about +2.77% and Pop Mart about -5.47%; A shares had not entered effective auction trading. If resources hold prior closes and QQQ stays positive, selective resource and tech strength can extend. Rapid gap fills or an oil-driven yield rise would invalidate the overnight signal.

Pre-open Conclusion

Gold, copper and oil & gas drilling led Moomoo's industry ranking, BGL and ERO confirmed in overnight trading, and QQQ, SPY and DIA ETF proxies all edged higher, making precious metals, nonferrous metals and energy the first relative-strength checks at the A/H open.But only 49 of 145 industries rose while 96 fell, solar, aerospace & defense and discount stores sat near the bottom, and a 10-year yield near 4.70% plus Brent at $93.78 keep pressure on expensive and cost-sensitive groups.

Tech is not a broad risk-on move: Sparks storage +3.72%, semiconductor industry +0.75% and optical communication +0.65%, but semiconductor breadth was 19 up versus 52 down, optical breadth seven up versus 14 down, and MRVL and LITE slipped 0.521% and 0.435% overnight. Trade only CPO, storage and domestic compute names that confirm on volume.

Hong Kong auction indications favored Zijin, Alibaba, NetEase and Ping An, but representativeness is limited, especially where NetEase conflicts with the US cash reaction. After 09:30 CST, keeping Zijin H above HK$36.76, Alibaba above HK$126.20 and seeing broader semiconductor and optical volume would support selective offense; otherwise rotate toward gold, insurance and cash-flow defense.

Logic Chain

US pressure on Iran lifts oil and long yields while all three US cash indexes fall, leaving macro risk appetite weak.
Moomoo's complete industry ranking puts gold, copper and drilling near the top, while solar, aerospace & defense and discount stores sit near the bottom.
Futu overnight data confirm BGL, ERO, HUDI and BEEM in the panel direction, but six panel representatives do not trade, preventing a broad extrapolation.
Sparks storage, optical communication and semiconductors provide A/H tech mappings, but weak breadth changes the condition to post-open volume confirmation.
If resources hold prior closes, QQQ stays positive and tech volume broadens, retain selective offense. If yields rise or auction gaps fill, reduce expensive exposure.

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
期指
三大期指反弹，纳指约涨0.6%领跑
美联社在周五美东盘前显示，纳指期指约涨0.6%、道指期指约涨0.4%、标普500期指约涨0.3%。这是周四急跌后的技术性修复，尚不能单独确认周线下行结束。
周线
三大指数本周仍可能同步收跌
截至盘前，道指、标普500和纳指本周分别约跌1.81%、1.85%和2.48%；若收盘维持，将是一个月来首次三大指数同时周跌。反弹更适合看相对强弱，不宜直接等同趋势反转。
利率
10年期美债重返约4.70%，30年期约5.25%
财政部扩大长债回购带来的收益率回落迅速消退；路透盘前显示10年期约4.704%、30年期约5.251%。高融资成本仍是高估值科技和小盘成长的主要折现率约束。
财政
长债回购暂未压住“债券义勇军”
美国财政部已宣布至少翻倍长期国债回购规模，财长并暗示仍可扩大，但市场对政府债务、供给与通胀的担忧使长端利率重新上行。政策工具改善流动性，不等于消除期限溢价。
数据
美国8月标普全球PMI初值将成为开盘后第一道验证
8月制造业与服务业PMI初值定于美东09:45公布。强数据可能支撑盈利预期却推高利率，弱数据可能缓和收益率却放大增长担忧，市场反应取决于“增长—通胀—利率”组合。
零售
Ross Stores上调全年利润展望，盘前涨近9%
Ross Stores二季度结果好于预期，并上调全年利润指引、预计下季销售增长强于市场预期；路透显示盘前涨幅由约8.1%扩大至接近9%。业绩、指引与价格反馈同向，强于昨日受压的零售板块。
加密
比特币本周涨约22%，加密股票盘前延续强势
美联社盘前报价显示比特币约76,935美元、本周上涨约22%；Stocktwits盘前追踪显示Coinbase、Strategy与Marathon Digital继续走强。价格反馈明显优于大盘，但高波动和追高回撤风险同样突出。
大型科技
多数巨头盘前回升，但仍属选择性修复
路透称多数大型科技股盘前走高，推动纳指期指领先；不过本周AI与半导体去估值压力尚未完全消退。只有开盘后成交扩散且相对纳指继续走强，才可确认风险偏好回归。
防务科技
AeroVironment希腊扩张计划获盘前约1%正反馈
AeroVironment宣布通过AV Eagle在希腊建立工业布局，早盘前约涨1%。事件与地缘安全支出主题一致，但涨幅不大，需观察开盘后订单预期与成交量是否同步强化。
财报日历
今晚没有可验证的大型科技盘后财报
TheStreet、StockTi、Kiplinger/Briefing.com与Earnings Whispers均未确认大型科技公司今晚盘后披露；Ubiquiti被列为盘前或时点待定，不能挪作盘后样本。唯一明确盘后样本OWLS规模小、覆盖稀疏。

盘前结论

三大期指反弹且纳指领先，Ross Stores财报缺口、加密链延续强势和多数大型科技盘前回升，支持开盘先走技术性修复。但本周三大指数仍跌约1.8%—2.5%，反弹首先是风险再平衡而非确认新升势。

10年期约4.70%、30年期约5.25%，说明财政部长债回购尚未压住期限溢价；霍尔木兹与伊朗制裁风险又把油价—通胀链条留在桌面上。基准情景是指数高开后分化，加密、折扣零售与有硬事件的科技/防务相对占优。

若09:45 PMI后10Y继续上行并重返4.72%以上，纳指反弹可能快速收窄；若收益率稳定、ROST守住财报缺口且COIN/MSTR/MARA成交继续扩张，则选择性风险偏好可延续到午盘。

纳指反弹 长债高压 加密动量 周线承压 霍尔木兹 ROST强反馈 巨头修复 债券回购 防务科技 期指广度 高开回落 财报真空
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

Ross Stores
ROST
财报缺口

推荐理由：二季度结果、上调全年利润指引与下季销售展望同向超预期，盘前涨近9%、显著强于零售板块；财报事件带来活跃价格发现。

触发因素：开盘后守住盘前缺口、成交继续放大且相对XRT和TJX保持强势。

风险点：高开获利回吐、消费者放缓或毛利压力可能削弱指引带来的估值溢价。

Coinbase
COIN
加密平台

推荐理由：比特币本周涨约22%至约76,935美元，公开盘前追踪显示COIN继续走强、相对纳指和金融科技更有动量；来源未披露精确盘前量，仓位置信度相应下调。

触发因素：开盘后成交扩张、守住盘前方向并与MSTR/MARA保持板块共振。

风险点：加密资产价格、交易量和监管预期高度敏感，冲高回落会迅速反噬高贝塔股票。

Strategy
MSTR
比特币高贝塔

推荐理由：公开盘前追踪显示MSTR随比特币与加密股票继续上行，价格反馈明显强于本周承压的大盘；精确盘前成交量未公开，因此只作动量候选。

触发因素：比特币维持76,000美元上方、MSTR开盘成交放大并强于COIN/MARA均值。

风险点：资产净值溢价、融资结构和比特币急跌会放大回撤，禁止在板块失速时追高。

AeroVironment
AVAV
防务科技事件

推荐理由：希腊工业布局计划带来约1%盘前正反馈，方向与地缘安全和欧洲防务支出主题一致；相对强度为正但幅度温和。

触发因素：开盘后放量站稳盘前区间，并由防务ETF或无人系统同业同步走强确认。

风险点：消息缺乏即时订单金额，若成交不跟随，1%的盘前涨幅可能不足以形成趋势。

板块轮动看板

强势观察加密平台与矿企、Ross Stores代表的折扣零售，以及有事件正反馈的防务科技；大型科技只看相对承接。
事件驱动财政部长债回购、伊朗与霍尔木兹谈判、ROST财报缺口、比特币周度大涨和09:45 ET美国PMI。
压力方向高久期软件与无盈利成长、融资敏感小盘、航空运输，以及没有成交确认的AI反弹。
验证信号10Y能否守住4.72%下方、纳指期指涨幅是否保留、ROST缺口和COIN/MSTR/MARA量价能否延续。

逻辑链

周四债券与股票同步承压后，三大期指反弹，空头回补首先抬高纳指和多数大型科技。
长债回购改善市场流动性，却未消除财政供给与通胀担忧，10Y和30Y仍处高位。
因此资金集中到有明确价格反馈的ROST、加密链与防务事件，而非无差别买入高估值成长。
若PMI后收益率稳定且强势股放量，修复可延续；若10Y突破4.72%或油价再冲高，指数更可能高开回落。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为基于已知一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气的主观判断，不是确定事实。已检查TheStreet、StockTi、Kiplinger/Briefing.com、Earnings Whispers及公司披露；今晚可验证的大型科技公司样本不足。

高概率 · 暂无可验证科技样本日历没有确认的大型科技公司在8月21日盘后披露，不能用下周NVDA、CRM、CRWD或今日盘前UI替代今晚样本。
中概率 · 暂无可验证科技样本Ubiquiti (UI)被日历列为盘前或时点待定，且预期电话会在09:30 ET，已不是可确认的盘后候选；因此不赋今晚beat概率。
低概率 · OBOOK Holdings (OWLS) · 45%TheStreet列OWLS为今晚盘后，市场预期EPS约0.01美元、营收约907万美元。其数字内容业务规模小、卖方覆盖和历史surprise样本稀疏，近期指引与修正证据不足，故仅给低置信度、低于五成的判断。

风险雷达

长端收益率再上冲

10Y约4.70%、30Y约5.25%；若PMI偏强或债券供给担忧升温，高估值科技可能再次承压。

霍尔木兹与油价尾险

谈判进展有限且美国威胁扩大对伊朗压力，任何航运冲击都可能把油价、通胀和利率同时推高。

加密链高波动回撤

比特币周涨约22%后拥挤度上升；若币价跌破盘前支撑，COIN、MSTR和MARA可能出现放大回撤。

反弹缺乏成交扩散

多数巨头盘前回升但公开来源未给统一量能；若开盘广度不扩散，期指涨幅可能演变为高开低走。

数据来源与时间点

entries.html_en:
Major News
Futures
All three futures rebound, with Nasdaq up about 0.6%
AP's Friday U.S. premarket snapshot showed Nasdaq futures up about 0.6%, Dow futures up about 0.4% and S&P 500 futures up about 0.3%. This is a technical recovery after Thursday's sharp decline, not yet proof that the weekly downtrend is over.
Weekly
All three indexes still face a weekly loss
Before the open, the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq were down about 1.81%, 1.85% and 2.48% for the week. If sustained, this would be the first simultaneous weekly decline for all three in a month, so the rebound is better treated as a relative-strength test than a confirmed reversal.
Rates
The 10-year returns to about 4.70%; the 30-year is near 5.25%
The yield relief from expanded Treasury buybacks faded quickly. Reuters showed the 10-year near 4.704% and the 30-year near 5.251% premarket, leaving financing costs as the main discount-rate constraint on expensive technology and small-cap growth.
Fiscal
Long-bond buybacks have not subdued bond vigilantes
The U.S. Treasury said it would at least double long-duration debt repurchases, and the Treasury secretary signaled more could follow. Debt, supply and inflation concerns nevertheless pushed long yields higher again: the tool helps liquidity but does not erase the term premium.
Data
The August U.S. flash PMI is the first post-open test
Flash manufacturing and services PMIs are scheduled for 9:45 a.m. ET. Strong data may support earnings expectations but raise yields; weak data may ease rates but amplify growth concerns, so the market response depends on the growth-inflation-rate combination.
Retail
Ross Stores raises its annual profit outlook and jumps nearly 9%
Ross Stores beat second-quarter expectations, raised full-year profit guidance and projected next-quarter sales growth above consensus. Reuters showed its premarket gain widening from roughly 8.1% to nearly 9%, aligning results, guidance and price feedback while outperforming the retail group pressured Thursday.
Crypto
Bitcoin is up about 22% this week and crypto stocks extend premarket strength
AP showed Bitcoin near $76,935, up roughly 22% for the week. Stocktwits' premarket tracking said Coinbase, Strategy and Marathon Digital continued higher. The price feedback is much stronger than the broad market, but so is the risk of a high-volatility reversal.
Megacaps
Most megacaps recover premarket, but the repair remains selective
Reuters said most large technology stocks traded higher premarket, helping Nasdaq futures lead. This week's AI and semiconductor derating is not fully repaired, however; only broader opening volume and continued relative strength versus Nasdaq would confirm renewed risk appetite.
Defense tech
AeroVironment's Greece expansion plan receives about 1% positive feedback
AeroVironment announced plans to establish an industrial presence in Greece through AV Eagle, lifting the stock about 1% in early premarket trading. The event fits geopolitical-security spending, but the modest move still needs opening volume and order expectations to confirm it.
Calendar
No verifiable large technology company reports after the close
TheStreet, StockTi, Kiplinger/Briefing.com and Earnings Whispers do not confirm a large technology reporter tonight. Ubiquiti is listed before the open or time-to-be-determined and cannot be moved into the after-hours sample; OWLS is the only clear after-close name but is small and sparsely covered.

Premarket View

All three futures are higher with Nasdaq leading, while Ross Stores' earnings gap, continued crypto strength and a recovery in most megacaps support an initial technical rebound.But all three indexes remain down about 1.8%-2.5% this week, making this risk rebalancing before it is a confirmed new uptrend.

The 10-year near 4.70% and 30-year near 5.25% show that Treasury buybacks have not suppressed the term premium; Hormuz and Iran-sanctions risk keeps the oil-inflation channel active.The base case is a higher open followed by dispersion, with crypto, off-price retail and hard-catalyst technology or defense outperforming.

If the 10-year rises through 4.72% after the 9:45 PMI, the Nasdaq rebound could fade quickly. If yields stabilize, ROST holds its earnings gap and COIN/MSTR/MARA volume expands, selective risk appetite can persist into midday.

roughly flat / high tail risk

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage moves.

Focus Stocks

Ross Stores
ROST
Earnings gap

Why it stands out: second-quarter results, raised annual profit guidance and next-quarter sales expectations all beat, sending the stock nearly 9% higher premarket and well ahead of retail; earnings created active price discovery.

Trigger: hold the premarket gap after the open with expanding volume and sustained relative strength versus XRT and TJX.

Risk: profit-taking after a high open, consumer slowing or margin pressure could erode the guidance premium.

Coinbase
COIN
Crypto platform

Why it stands out: Bitcoin is up about 22% this week near $76,935, and public premarket tracking says COIN remains higher with better momentum than Nasdaq and fintech; exact premarket volume was not published, reducing conviction.

Trigger: opening volume expansion, retention of the premarket direction and continued confirmation from MSTR and MARA.

Risk: sensitivity to crypto prices, trading volume and regulation can turn a momentum gain into a rapid high-beta reversal.

Strategy

Capital therefore concentrates in ROST, crypto and defense events with clear price feedback instead of buying all expensive growth.
